metadata.source: PSOC - Enable Remote Connection Between Anonymous Computer.yaml

metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.displayName: PSOC - Enable Remote Connection Between Anonymous Computer
properties.description: Detects enabling of the "AllowAnonymousCallback" registry value, which allows a remote connection between computers that do not have a trust relationship.
properties.query:
//Detects enabling of the "AllowAnonymousCallback" registry value, which allows a remote connection between computers that do not have a trust relationship.
_Im_ProcessCreate
| where TargetProcessName has "reg.exe"
| where CommandLine has "HKLM\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\WBEM\\CIMOM"
| where CommandLine has_all ("/t REG_DWORD","/d 1")
| extend
    Account = tostring(column_ifexists("ActorUsername", "")),
    AccountDomain = tostring(column_ifexists("ActorUserDomain", "")),
    Computer = tostring(column_ifexists("DvcHostname", "")),
    ProcessName = tostring(column_ifexists("TargetProcessName", "")),
    ProcessId = tostring(column_ifexists("TargetProcessId", "")),
    CommandLine = tostring(column_ifexists("CommandLine", ""))
| where isnotempty(ProcessName)
